text:
Asha: Quick thread on tenant failback/consistency guardrails. Sketch: prefer-active-active, but must enforce residency and write-consistency policies.
Ben: Agree. Propose guardrail: if tenant.residency==true then require-local=true on lease. No cross-site writes.
Ravi: For non-residency tenants, allow controlled failback with a reconciliation window. Need conflict policy per data-type.
Clara: Suggest table: inference requests=idempotent, metadata=merge-CRDT, billing=append-only. Also record who performed failback in audit.
Asha: Operator behaviour: during failback, mark tenant in "in-migration" and throttle new writes until sweep completes. ops-bot should block cutover if migrations>0 in last 10m.
Ben: Telemetry: emit metric tenant_failback_state{tenant,from_site,to_site,phase} with phases: prepare, throttled, sweep, done.
Ravi: Auto-priming: when affinity shifts, do header-only prefetch for residency tenants (consent-stamp only). Full payloads for others.
Clara: Tests: simulate site kill + failback, check no EU-tenant payload leaves region, check billing events never duplicated.
Asha: I'll draft a tiny RFC with the guardrails, conflict table, and operator preflight checklist. Tagging owners for review.
ops-bot: [alert] preflight check will fail if migrations>0 in last 10m.
